patch.value: Add version-aware Jellyfin API compatibility manifests

Add a read-only agent-first compatibility surface that compares the configured live OpenAPI contract with trusted official stable or explicitly opted-in preview schemas, classifies operation and component-schema drift, emits schema-validated structured formats, and supports CI breaking-change gates without exposing private server data.

Default comparison uses the configured live document and its exact official stable version without forwarding credentials; Explicit version comparison supports Jellyfin 12 prerelease only with an opt-in flag and validates official source identity; Operation additions removals identifier changes parameter requiredness body and response drift plus component schema drift are deterministically classified; TOON JSON YAML Markdown table and raw formats are schema-valid and documented with detailed nested help; A fail-on-breaking CI mode returns nonzero only after emitting a complete machine-readable report; Unit integration installed-package and private compiled live read-only acceptance pass with no secrets or live mutations
Let agents and maintainers reason about upgrades and server-specific API drift before invoking operations.
Prevents silent API incompatibility across Jellyfin stable upgrades previews and plugin-extended local servers.
A deterministic privacy-safe compatibility manifest and CI gate for current and future Jellyfin API contracts.
The exact-operation fallback provides reach but agents still lack evidence about version drift and breaking contract changes; Jellyfin 12 RC3 makes this gap immediate.
